name: yakey
description: Яндекс Ключ для Linux: импорт облачного бэкапа, TOTP и Yandex OTP

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --composite false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false
scripts.dist:deb: npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb --publish never
scripts.dist:pacman: npm run build && electron-builder --linux pacman --publish never
scripts.dist:rpm: npm run build && electron-builder --linux rpm --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
